selection_rules: Within each fixedE174/E175/E176 directory, include all existing regular files ending .md/.py/.cpp/.hpp/.csv/.png/.svg.
Include .json files whose first campaign-relative path component is outside models/results/smoke/smoke_results/fit_results/smoke_original.
Additionally include compact models/*/compile_manifest.json, every formal results/**/*.json, and every fit_results/**/*.json completion/administrative receipt.
Additionally include onlyE176 models/**/*.i32 compact trained tables:40 files,1667988 bytes; no other .i32 raw data.
Include exact root AGENTS.md/summary.md/spec.md/s-target.md/s-experiment.md plus experiment_history/README.md and exact174/175/176 history files.
Selections are exact current existing paths, deduplicated; no new portable reader/docs/manifest or this whitelist itself is included. Parent adds new publication files separately.
Retain originals byte-for-byte. Portable relative-link reading copies, if added, are new derived artifacts with their own provenance rather than edits to frozen reports.
excluded_categories: Formal/FIT/smoke per-query raw returns, scalar score arrays, routes, counters, candidate traces, teacher response/status arrays (.i32/.f32/.u64/.u8/.i64 etc), except the explicit40 E176 compact model tables.
Scored per-query NPZ packages; aggregate CSV/JSON and audit receipts are selected instead.
Platform ELF executables and native build products; preserve their recorded SHA identity in selected receipts.
Execution logs and other unselected suffixes; no log bytes copied.
Dense models/*.selection_log.json training target selection details; compact manifest statistics and model-table identities remain selected.
Smoke per-point metadata/packets remain server-side; top-level actualqualification/smoke audit receipts and source contracts are selected.

External base vectors, NSG graphs, originalTRAIN/public arrays, GT10 profile/Micro-HNSW and oldM5 binary assets, dependencies and .venv_cpu/build trees are outside these campaign white-listed paths and remain server dependencies.
Large external inputs are not read or freshly hashed here. Parent external-asset manifest should reuse recorded identity/SHA with explicit provenance and current metadata scope.
Existing preserved published snapshot/history outside the selected174–176 set is retained by the publication parent tree, not re-added from the dirty server worktree.
